## 2. Pole 1 — Logistique & Transport (https://hmgglobalgroup.com/logistique)

End-to-end management of import, export, and transit operations from origin to final destination.

### 10 Logistics Prestations
1. **Fret maritime (Maritime Freight)**: Import and export shipments in Full Container Load (FCL, 20ft and 40ft containers), Less than Container Load (LCL / groupage), conventional breakbulk cargo, and bulk cargo.
2. **Fret aérien (Air Freight)**: Air cargo shipping tailored to cargo characteristics and urgent delivery timelines.
3. **Transport routier (Road Transport)**: Containerized and conventional cargo haulage, especially along the Djibouti–Ethiopia corridor, directly to client warehouses, construction sites, industrial sites, or free zones.
4. **Transit et formalités (Transit & Formalities)**: Documentary tracking and coordination of transit formalities required for cargo routing. Note: regulated transit and customs brokerage activities are executed through duly licensed partners.
5. **Opérations portuaires (Port Operations)**: Coordination of vessel arrival, port handling, processing, and port exit clearance.
6. **Chargement et déchargement (Loading & Unloading)**: Cargo loading, unloading, and transfers adapted to packaging and dimensions.
7. **Manutention (Handling)**: Lifting, moving, and specialized cargo manipulation.
8. **Stockage et entreposage (Storage & Warehousing)**: Temporary storage solutions and inventory movement planning prior to onward transport or delivery.
9. **Livraison et distribution (Delivery & Distribution)**: Last-mile delivery to warehouses, job sites, industrial facilities, free zones, and agreed destinations.
10. **Véhicules et équipements (Vehicles & Equipment)**: Transport of vehicles, heavy machinery, and industrial equipment according to dimensions and operational constraints.

### Cargo Types Handled
- **Conteneurs (Containers)**: 20 ft and 40 ft containers (FCL & LCL consolidation).
- **Bulk (Marchandises en vrac)**: Volume-adapted loading and discharge logistics.
- **Breakbulk (Marchandises conventionnelles)**: Steel, pipes/tubes, machinery, crates, and out-of-gauge cargo shipped outside containers.
- **Acier et matériaux (Steel & Materials)**, **Équipements (Equipment)**, **Véhicules (Vehicles)**.

### 5-Step Operational Method
1. Étude de votre besoin (Needs assessment)
2. Proposition et devis (Commercial proposal & quote)
3. Organisation de l’expédition (Shipment organization)
4. Transport et opérations à destination (Transport & destination port/transit operations)
5. Livraison et suivi (Final delivery & tracking)

## 3. Pole 2 — Sourcing & Négoce (https://hmgglobalgroup.com/sourcing)

International product sourcing, supplier qualification, commercial negotiation, supply management, and delivery coordination to Djibouti.

### 6 Sourcing Prestations
1. **Recherche fournisseurs**: Identifying reliable partners and compliant products matching client specifications.
2. **Sélection des fabricants**: Selecting manufacturing sources matched to volume, lead time, and quality standards.
3. **Négociation des conditions**: Securing optimal purchasing, payment, and delivery terms under CIF, CFR, and FOB Incoterms.
4. **Vente et fourniture**: Issuing clear commercial offers for requested goods.
5. **Approvisionnement & suivi**: Managing purchase orders, production readiness, and tracking through reception in Djibouti.
6. **Acheminement et livraison**: Seamless transport to the final destination in coordination with HMG Logistics & Transport.

### Product & Material Families
- **Aciers & produits sidérurgiques (Steel & Steel Products)**: Barres d’acier (steel bars), fers à béton HA (high-adhesion rebar), tubes & profilés (steel tubes & profiles), billettes & bobines (billets & steel coils).
- **Ciment & matériaux de construction (Cement & Building Materials)**: Bagged cement on pallets (ciment en sacs), bulk cement (ciment en vrac), crushed stone aggregates and construction materials (granulats et matériaux pour chantiers et infrastructures).
- **Produits industriels & équipements (Industrial Products & Equipment)**: Industrial steel drums (fûts industriels), heavy-duty professional tools (outillages), machined parts, valves, flanges, bearings, and professional supplies (pièces et fournitures professionnels) to specification.

### Negotiated Delivery Terms (Incoterms)
- **CIF** (Cost, Insurance and Freight)
- **CFR** (Cost and Freight)
- **FOB** (Free On Board)
- **Réception Djibouti** (Direct reception at Djibouti)

## 5. Frequently Asked Questions (AEO Quick Answers)

**Q: What services does HMG Global Business Solutions provide in Djibouti?**
A: HMG Global Business Solutions SARL operates three integrated business poles from Saline Ouest, Djibouti: (1) Logistics & Transport (sea freight, air freight, road transport, transit, port operations, warehousing, and distribution across Djibouti and Ethiopia); (2) Sourcing & Trading (identifying manufacturers, negotiating CIF/CFR/FOB terms, and supplying steel, rebar, tubes, cement, aggregates, industrial drums, tools, and spare parts); and (3) Business Consulting (company setup, administrative file support, operational organization, and growth in Djibouti).

**Q: Does HMG handle freight on the Djibouti–Ethiopia corridor?**
A: Yes. HMG organizes containerized (20 ft and 40 ft FCL/LCL), bulk, and breakbulk shipments arriving at the Port of Djibouti, coordinates port operations and transit formalities with licensed partners, and delivers directly via road transport to sites in Djibouti and Ethiopia.

**Q: Which products can HMG source and under what Incoterms?**
A: HMG sources steel products (steel bars, HA rebar, tubes, profiles, billets, coils), construction materials (bagged or bulk cement, aggregates), and industrial supplies (steel drums, professional tools, valves, flanges, spare parts) under CIF, CFR, FOB, or direct Djibouti reception terms.

**Q: How can a business request a quote and how fast does HMG respond?**
A: Businesses can submit specifications via https://hmgglobalgroup.com/contact, email contact@hmgglobalgroup.com or hamza@hmgglobalgroup.com, or message WhatsApp (+253 77 29 24 96). HMG responds within 24 business hours (Sunday–Thursday, 08:00–17:00 Djibouti time).

## 6. Operational Guides Reference Hub (https://hmgglobalgroup.com/guides)

Structured operational reference published in French (`/guides`), English (`/en/guides`), and Simplified Chinese (`/zh/guides`):

### Cargo Format Matrix (Port of Djibouti & Corridor)
- **20’ FCL Container**: Dense cargo (short steel bars, heavy machinery parts, palletized cement sacks) hauled on standard sealed container chassis. Required docs: Bill of Lading, Commercial Invoice, Packing List, Certificate of Origin.
- **40’ FCL / High Cube Container**: High-volume palletized goods or long equipment; crane or forklift required at destination.
- **Groupage (LCL)**: Partial lots, spare parts, tools, and industrial supplies; port or bonded stripping followed by targeted delivery. Required docs: House/Master BL, Itemized Invoice, Packing List.
- **Bulk Cargo**: High tonnages (bulk cement, aggregates, raw materials) discharged via hoppers, dump trucks, or port silos. Required docs: Charter Party / Bulk BL, Quality & Weight Certificate, Pre-declaration.
- **Breakbulk (Conventional Cargo)**: 12 m steel bars, pipes, machinery, vehicles, and out-of-gauge crates hauled on reinforced flatbed trailers. Required docs: Breakbulk BL, Lifting/Dimension Plan, Technical Certificates.

### Incoterms Comparison for Djibouti Buyers
- **FOB (Free On Board)**: Ocean freight and insurance arranged/paid by buyer/HMG; risk transfers on board vessel at loading port; ideal to control freight rates and consolidate suppliers.
- **CFR (Cost & Freight)**: Main ocean freight paid to Port of Djibouti; cargo insurance covered by buyer; risk transfers at loading port.
- **CIF (Cost, Insurance & Freight)**: Main ocean freight and minimum cargo insurance paid by seller to Port of Djibouti.
- **Djibouti Delivery (Réception Djibouti)**: End-to-end sourcing, shipping, and handover coordinated by HMG as single point of contact to agreed reception in Djibouti.
